speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are pregnant and presenting with fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise; to narrow down the cause, how many weeks pregnant are you and when did these symptoms first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection)

Given the specific combination of flu-like symptoms, anorexia, and your recent consumption of ice cream at 30 weeks gestation, I strongly suspect listeriosis. I need to confirm this by checking your results immediately. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture and Urine_Culture. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Pelvis_Ultrasound.
